paper_metadata.title: Hierarchical crystal plasticity FE model for nickel-based superalloys: Sub-grain microstructures to polycrystalline aggregates
paper_metadata.journal: International Journal of Solids and Structures

evidence.section: 2.4 Parameter calibration and validation of the constitutive law
evidence.quote: Selected constitutive parameters in the crystal plasticity model for c /C0c0 phase Ni-based superalloys with APB shearing have been calibrated for the alloy CMSX-4 (Ni, Cr-6.4, Co-9.3, Al-5.45, Ta-6.3, W-6.2, Ti-0.9, Mo-0.5, Re-2.8 in wt%) in Keshavarz and Ghosh (2013).
